eval_results.note_dense_ppl_discrepancy: Dense PPL 6.12 differs from BCE baseline reported 27.96; same evaluate.py, cause TBD

sparsity_collapse_analysis.root_cause: KL loss magnitude (~556) overwhelms sparsity regularizer (~0.017) by ~32700:1. Predictor learns trivial solution (keep all neurons). Gumbel tau annealing (1.0->0.1) locks in all-ones mask before reg takes effect.
sparsity_collapse_analysis.kl_loss_magnitude: initial ~556, final ~3.3 (batchmean KL on 128K-vocab logits, T=1.0)
sparsity_collapse_analysis.why_bce_works: BCE ~0.5-0.7 per neuron, directly teaches neuron selection via binary targets. Inherently encodes sparsity structure.
sparsity_collapse_analysis.model_sparsity_below_target: 0.372 < 0.5 because predictor scores cluster tightly, causing ties at global threshold
fix_suggestions: Two-phase: BCE pre-train then KL fine-tune
Normalize KL: divide by seq_len or per-token reduction
Delay tau annealing: keep tau=1.0 during warmup

comparison_with_bce.note: KL ~10x worse than BCE due to sparsity collapse

missing_eval_reason: Neither train_kl() nor train_bce() calls evaluate.py. Both only save checkpoint + wandb.finish(). BCE eval was a separate manual step.
